name: The Pipe
blurb: The Pipe in Fallout 76: the named pipe pistol with the A True Believer effect. How to get it from the Unusual Pipe random encounter, its full stat line, every mod it takes and how to max out its damage bonus.

overview.legendary_note: Drops with 4 legendary stars, each one rolled at random.

obtain.source: Random Encounter: Unusual Pipe - a chance each time you sniff the pipe
obtain.rate_note: The chance is set on Bethesda's servers. Nothing in the game files hands The Pipe out, so there is no percentage to show.
conditions: Sniff the pipe yourself - the pipe's script only fires for players
The Unusual Pipe is one of many Object random encounters, so it won't be at every encounter point you visit
Appalachia encounter points only - Skyline Valley and Burning Springs run their own encounter pools, so it never spawns there

mods.note: Every mod the base Pipe takes - The Pipe takes the same ones. Mods marked 'Comes on The Pipe' are the parts it drops with. Each mod's numbers include the shared template mods it pulls in, and a scrap chance is the chance to learn that mod each time you scrap one. Legendary effects are rolled separately and are not listed here.
